title: Cybersecurity Fundamentals
subtitle: Zero se Hero tak — complete beginner to advanced roadmap
description: Practical cybersecurity course jo aapko phishing, network security, cryptography, ethical hacking, aur modern AI-era defense sikhaata hai. Har lesson me theory + hands-on + real-world examples.

modules.title: Introduction to Cybersecurity
modules.desc: Cybersecurity kya hai, threat landscape, career paths, ethical boundaries.

lessons.title: What is Cybersecurity?
lessons.desc: CIA triad (Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability), security vs privacy, why it matters.
lessons.outcome: Cybersecurity ke basic concepts samjhoge aur threat landscape visualize kar paoge.

lessons.title: Threat Landscape 2026
lessons.desc: Modern attack types — phishing, ransomware, supply chain, AI-driven attacks. Stats + real cases.
lessons.outcome: Aaj ke top threats identify kar paoge aur unke against defend kar paoge.

lessons.title: Cyber Laws & Ethics
lessons.desc: IT Act 2000, DPDP Act 2023, GDPR, ethical hacking rules, white hat vs black hat.
lessons.outcome: Legal boundaries jaange aur ethical hacking ka framework samjhoge.

lessons.title: Career Paths in Security
lessons.desc: SOC analyst, pentester, security engineer, CISO — kya karte hain, kaise bane.
lessons.outcome: Apna career path choose kar paoge with roadmap.

lessons.title: Setting Up Your Lab
lessons.desc: Virtual machines, Kali Linux, metasploitable, isolated lab environment setup.
lessons.outcome: Apna personal hacking lab bana paoge safely.

modules.title: Authentication & Access Control
modules.desc: Passwords, 2FA, MFA, passkeys, OAuth, SSO, session management.

lessons.title: Password Security Deep Dive
lessons.desc: Password hashing (bcrypt, argon2), salting, common attacks, breach detection.
lessons.outcome: Password storage secure kar paoge aur attacks se bach paoge.

lessons.title: 2FA / MFA Explained
lessons.desc: TOTP, HOTP, push notifications, hardware keys (YubiKey), MFA fatigue attacks.
lessons.outcome: Right MFA type choose kar paoge aur bypass attacks detect kar paoge.

lessons.title: Passkeys & Passwordless
lessons.desc: FIDO2 standard, passkey implementation, migration strategy, phishing immunity.
lessons.outcome: Passkeys implement kar paoge aur users ko migrate karwa paoge.

lessons.title: OAuth 2.0 & OIDC
lessons.desc: Authorization flows, tokens, consent phishing, third-party apps security.
lessons.outcome: OAuth securely implement kar paoge aur consent attacks rok paoge.

lessons.title: SSO & SAML
lessons.desc: Enterprise SSO, SAML assertions, IDP/SP model, common misconfigurations.
lessons.outcome: Enterprise SSO design kar paoge securely.

lessons.title: Session Management
lessons.desc: Cookies, session IDs, HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite flags, session hijacking.
lessons.outcome: Session security strong kar paoge aur hijacking rok paoge.

modules.title: Phishing & Social Engineering
modules.desc: Sab types of phishing, social engineering techniques, defense strategies.

lessons.title: Anatomy of Phishing Attack
lessons.desc: Email structure, sender spoofing, link manipulation, credential harvesting pages.
lessons.outcome: Phishing email identify kar paoge aur report kar paoge.

lessons.title: Advanced Spear & Whaling
lessons.desc: OSINT for targeting, pretexting, BEC attacks, wire fraud.
lessons.outcome: Targeted attacks recognize kar paoge.

lessons.title: Deepfakes & AI Phishing
lessons.desc: AI-generated phishing, voice cloning, deepfake video, detection techniques.
lessons.outcome: AI-era attacks identify kar paoge.

lessons.title: Multi-Channel Attacks
lessons.desc: Vishing, smishing, QR phishing, social media, calendar invites.
lessons.outcome: Har channel pe attack identify kar paoge.

lessons.title: Building Anti-Phishing Program
lessons.desc: Email gateway, user training, simulations, incident response, metrics.
lessons.outcome: Enterprise anti-phishing program design kar paoge.

modules.title: Network Security
modules.desc: TCP/IP, firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN, WiFi security, network attacks.

lessons.title: Network Fundamentals
lessons.desc: OSI model, TCP/IP stack, ports, protocols, packet analysis with Wireshark.
lessons.outcome: Network traffic analyze kar paoge.

lessons.title: Firewalls & IPS
lessons.desc: Packet filtering, stateful inspection, NGFW, IPS rules, bypass techniques.
lessons.outcome: Firewall rules configure kar paoge.

lessons.title: VPN & Secure Tunneling
lessons.desc: IPsec, WireGuard, OpenVPN, TLS tunnels, VPN misconfigurations.
lessons.outcome: Secure VPN setup kar paoge.

lessons.title: WiFi Security
lessons.desc: WPA2/WPA3, evil twin, deauth attacks, captive portals, public WiFi risks.
lessons.outcome: WiFi network secure kar paoge.

lessons.title: Network Attacks & Defense
lessons.desc: MITM, ARP spoofing, DNS poisoning, DDoS, detection and mitigation.
lessons.outcome: Network attacks detect aur defend kar paoge.

modules.title: Cryptography
modules.desc: Symmetric/asymmetric encryption, hashing, PKI, TLS, digital signatures.

lessons.title: Crypto Fundamentals
lessons.desc: Symmetric vs asymmetric, block vs stream ciphers, AES, modes of operation.
lessons.outcome: Symmetric crypto samjhoge aur use kar paoge.

lessons.title: Asymmetric Cryptography
lessons.desc: RSA, ECC, Diffie-Hellman, key exchange, forward secrecy.
lessons.outcome: Public-key crypto implement kar paoge.

lessons.title: Hashing & Integrity
lessons.desc: SHA-2/3, HMAC, Merkle trees, collision attacks, rainbow tables.
lessons.outcome: Data integrity verify kar paoge.

lessons.title: PKI & Certificates
lessons.desc: X.509, CAs, certificate chains, CT logs, certificate pinning.
lessons.outcome: Certificates manage kar paoge.

lessons.title: TLS/SSL Deep Dive
lessons.desc: TLS 1.3, handshake, cipher suites, HSTS, common misconfigurations.
lessons.outcome: TLS implement aur debug kar paoge.

modules.title: Web Application Security
modules.desc: OWASP Top 10, XSS, SQLi, CSRF, SSRF, API security.

lessons.title: OWASP Top 10
lessons.desc: 2021/2025 list, real-world examples, defenses for each.
lessons.outcome: Web app vulnerabilities identify kar paoge.

lessons.title: Injection Attacks
lessons.desc: SQL injection, NoSQL, command injection, XXE, prevention techniques.
lessons.outcome: Injection attacks exploit aur defend kar paoge (legally).

lessons.title: XSS & Client-Side
lessons.desc: Stored, reflected, DOM-based XSS, CSP, sanitization.
lessons.outcome: XSS vulnerabilities detect aur fix kar paoge.

lessons.title: CSRF, SSRF, Clickjacking
lessons.desc: Request forgery attacks, defenses (tokens, SameSite, headers).
lessons.outcome: Forgery attacks defend kar paoge.

lessons.title: API Security
lessons.desc: REST/GraphQL security, rate limiting, auth, input validation.
lessons.outcome: APIs secure kar paoge.

lessons.title: Reconnaissance
lessons.desc: Passive and active recon, OSINT tools, footprinting, information gathering.
lessons.outcome: Target reconnaissance kar paoge.

lessons.title: Vulnerability Scanning
lessons.desc: Nmap, Nessus, OpenVAS, scanning strategies, false positives.
lessons.outcome: Vulnerabilities scan aur prioritize kar paoge.

lessons.title: Exploitation Basics
lessons.desc: Metasploit, exploits, payloads, shells, post-exploitation.
lessons.outcome: Safe lab me exploitation practice kar paoge.

lessons.title: Reporting & Remediation
lessons.desc: Professional report writing, risk scoring (CVSS), remediation advice.
lessons.outcome: Professional pentest reports likh paoge.

modules.title: AI & Modern Threats
modules.desc: AI-powered attacks, prompt injection, deepfake defense, quantum-safe migration.

lessons.title: AI-Powered Attacks
lessons.desc: LLM-based phishing, voice cloning, agentic AI attacks, mitigation.
lessons.outcome: AI attacks identify aur defend kar paoge.

lessons.title: Prompt Injection & LLM Security
lessons.desc: Direct/indirect prompt injection, OWASP LLM Top 10, sandboxing.
lessons.outcome: LLM apps secure kar paoge.

lessons.title: Deepfake Detection
lessons.desc: AI vs AI, biological signals, liveness check, real-time detection.
lessons.outcome: Deepfakes detect kar paoge.

lessons.title: Quantum-Safe Migration
lessons.desc: Quantum threat, PQC standards (Kyber, Dilithium), hybrid migration.
lessons.outcome: Quantum-safe systems plan kar paoge.

lessons.title: Zero Trust Architecture
lessons.desc: Zero Trust principles, implementation, identity-first security.
lessons.outcome: Zero Trust architecture design kar paoge.
